patterns.rationale: Follow requests are approve/reject requests, but there is no routing, trail or reviewer structure; may be better seen as notification inline actions only.
Boosts/likes are shown only as aggregated notification content (who reacted, with per-person icons); no reaction controls on these items in the capture.

evidence.note: Avatar row of people who boosted/liked, each with heart/rocket mini-chips
List is a notification list rather than a post stream; a Home timeline exists in DOM behind the view but is not visible

structure.layout: single centered 640px column app view (Phanpy) with a sticky column header (menu, home, title, settings), collapsible server announcement, follow-requests list, day-grouped notification list, and a floating compose button bottom-right; wide empty gray margins on both sides

aesthetics.typography: ui-rounded system stack (renders as a rounded humanist sans, Ubuntu-like) for everything — titles, names, body, buttons; ui-monospace for inline code and code blocks in quoted posts
aesthetics.typeScale: Compact: h2 section heads 23px/700 ('Follow requests', 'Today'), h1 column title 19px/700, body and notification text 16px with bold counts/names, quoted-post text 14px, meta/timestamps 13–14px muted, badge labels ~10px uppercase

notes: Phanpy's signature look: narrow 640px centered column on light gray #f0f2f5, everything pill-shaped or 16px-rounded. Notifications are aggregated per post ('11 people boosted & liked your post') with a row of gradient-filled initial avatars, each carrying a tiny pill showing purple rocket (boost) and orange heart (like); left gutter shows the reason icon. Mentions render as white cards with orange #ff8c00 border plus warm glow; private mentions add a pale diagonal-stripe background and an orange outlined 'PRIVATE MENTION' tag. Quoted target posts appear as low-contrast outlined cards with faded image previews and a floating 'Read more →' pill. Accept is solid royal blue pill, Reject is outlined pill with orange-red text. Day headings pair a bold word with a muted weekday ('Today Tuesday'). A 'Mentions →' pill link sits right of the first day heading. Settings button opens a bottom sheet modal 'Notifications settings' with Accept/Filter/Ignore selects per source category (colored outlines green/orange) — not visible in the capture. Menu button opens a two-column dropdown nav with icons and submenus. Floating blue circular compose (feather) button at bottom-right. Capture also contains a hidden Home timeline column in the DOM behind the notifications view.
